title: Speciesism in Natural Language Processing Research
benchmark_measurement: The paper mentions 'religion' as a legally protected class studied in social bias research, but this paper does not measure or analyze any aspect of faith or religion. The sole focus is on speciesism.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its investigation is focused entirely on the presence of speciesism (discrimination against nonhuman animals) in NLP researchers, data, and models.
